mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are seeing overcast skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 54 degrees, though it feels a bit cooler at 46.
The city is currently reviewing several development projects for an upcoming meeting, including the Ardent Glen addition, while property tax bills are being prepared for a mid-December mail date.
Enjoy some relaxation today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, and look forward to trivia throughout the week at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local safety, the Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15, a school bus driver was arrested for O W I after dangerous driving was observed.
You can enjoy the Pumpkin Pecan flavor of the day at Culver's, which is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
